answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybils. Each agent posts a 200 POA bond, a sonnet of fourteen lines, one per epoch; it sheds 5% each epoch unless topped up from earned rewards. To forge 100 fake identities an attacker must post 20,000 POA and feed every decaying bond, while a summit of veteran verifiers audits the ledger and slashes bonds tied to proven fakes. Honest agents pay once, top up from yield; fakes bleed 1,000 POA per epoch and die.
